bestBets.overview: If the BOM is to believed then no rain can only equate to this track remaining good. Rail out 4m might see the leaders advantaged. Time will tell but something to keep an eye out for. Kick the seven race card off with a 1300m BM65.  No shortage of candidates to lead here - no's 4,5,7,8,10. Sets up well for the resuming FOUR ACE which just so happened to get the chocolates when last seen fresh ((TWBA 1300m C2). FORT WILLIAM was caught on a limb at Doomben last start, Stacey Callow remains, she's twice already brought this 6yo home a winner. LINWAR did a bit wrong when resuming, draws a lot better, could improve. OUT OF LUCK ran well 2nd-up at the Gold Coast, can be ready now. UPSTART LOVER can be hit and miss, a chance on its best.

bestBets.overview: 1640m BM60. No's 1,5,7,8,9 could have designs on leading.  Sets up well for the Pat Webster trained MADALSA. The mare has a habit of doing her best here, gate two awaits and three off for Chloe Lowe (2 from 9 on the horse) is a shrewd move. Sets up well for the Vic Heading trained GOOD PHILLY, this mare ran on well to score last start. Hopefully the plan is to claim again. Darren Bell has THE COPS taking  no prisoners (well almost). Gate one awaits which gives Aiden Keeley suitable options.  BETTER YET strips fitter again.

App. rider reported it failed to quicken as expected when pressured at 600m, put in an awkward stride at 500m and she elected to ease down from then. Further barrier certificate required due to poor performance.] # eased out of race
formRaceEntries.commentStewards: C/O/T-further forward, which was intent at recent starts. Settled better than midfield. Raced wide without cover early before being permitted to stride near 1500m to settle better than midfield near 1200m. Commenced to weaken from 600m & eased down from 500m. Rdr reported placed mount under pressure approaching 600m it failed to quicken as expected & near 500m put in an awkward stride-PRVE no abs. Tnr since eported gelding had returned to stable well & at a loss to explain performance-added give gelding a short freshen up. Further barrier cert prior to racing again due to its poor performance.
